code:
// RAIN + PLAYER FRAMES
// Rain = up to 6 drops on hardware sprites 2-7, Player slot 4 (pointer $A4).
// Each drop falls 4px a frame and drifts left like the drop graphic, with its own
// x speed of 1, 2 or 3 (the graphic's slope of 2, +/- 1 at random). A drop that
// reaches the split (y 182+, so it never shows in the text rows) or runs off the
// left edge starts again at the top somewhere new.
// While it rains every pumpkin is watered for free (rainWater).
// Player frames - pointer = $A0 + slot.  Sprite 1 = MC body ($63F9), sprite 0 =
// hi-res outline ($63F8).  Right: stand 0/1, pick 2/3.  Left: stand 5/6, pick 7/8.
RAIN_X   = $C400   // 6 x low bytes
RAIN_XH  = $C406   // 6 x high bits (0/1)
RAIN_Y   = $C40C   // 6 y
RAIN_DX  = $C412   // 6 x speeds (subtracted each frame)
RAINING  = $C418   // 1 = raining
RAIN_MSB = $C419   // $D010 bits being built
POSE_T   = $C41A   // frames left on the pick pose
FACING   = $C41B   // 0 right, 1 left

// ---- rainInit ----  once at start: scatter the drops, set up sprites 2-7
rainInit:
lda #$00
sta RAINING
sta POSE_T
sta FACING
ldx #$05
riLoop:
jsr rainSpawn
lda $d41b
and #$7f
clc
adc #50
sta RAIN_Y,x
lda #$a4
sta $63fa,x
lda #$0f
sta $d029,x
dex
bpl riLoop
lda $d01c
and #$03
sta $d01c
lda $d017
and #$03
sta $d017
lda $d01d
and #$03
sta $d01d
lda $d01b
and #$03
sta $d01b
rts

// ---- rainSpawn ----  IN X = drop.  New drop at the top, x 64..319. Y 48 puts the
// first pixel row (row 2) on raster 51, the first field line - any higher and
// it shows in the top border
rainSpawn:
lda $d41b
clc
adc #64
sta RAIN_X,x
lda #$00
adc #$00
sta RAIN_XH,x
lda #48
sta RAIN_Y,x
lda $d41b
and #$03
bne rsDx
lda #$02
rsDx:
sta RAIN_DX,x
rts

// ---- rainStart ----  start the rain and water everything in the field
rainStart:
lda #$01
sta RAINING
jmp rainWater

// ---- rainNewDay ----  after fieldEndDay.  TEST: it rains every day.
// Later: a random chance here, e.g.  lda $d41b / and #$03 / bne (dry day)
rainNewDay:
jmp rainStart

// ---- rainWater ----  every pumpkin (kind 1-7) watered + redrawn wet
rainWater:
ldx #$00
rwLoop:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$ff
beq rwDone
cmp #$fe
beq rwNext
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
beq rwNext
bmi rwNext
lda PUMPKINS+3,x
bne rwNext
lda #$01
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
jsr drawRecord
rwNext:
ldx UV_PUMPIDX
inx
inx
inx
inx
bne rwLoop
rwDone:
rts

// ---- frameFx ----  every frame from the main loop: pick pose timer + rain
frameFx:
lda POSE_T
beq ffRain
dec POSE_T
bne ffRain
jsr playerFrame
ffRain:
lda RAINING
bne ruOn
lda $d015
and #$03
sta $d015
rts
ruOn:
ldx #$05
ruLoop:
lda RAIN_Y,x
clc
adc #$04
sta RAIN_Y,x
cmp #182
bcs ruNew
lda RAIN_X,x
sec
sbc RAIN_DX,x
sta RAIN_X,x
bcs ruNext
lda RAIN_XH,x
beq ruNew
lda #$00
sta RAIN_XH,x
jmp ruNext
ruNew:
jsr rainSpawn
ruNext:
dex
bpl ruLoop
// drop n -> sprite n+2 at $D004 + 2n, x high bits gathered into RAIN_MSB
lda #$00
sta RAIN_MSB
ldx #$05
ldy #$0a
ruVic:
lda RAIN_X,x
sta $d004,y
lda RAIN_Y,x
sta $d005,y
lda RAIN_XH,x
lsr
rol RAIN_MSB
dey
dey
dex
bpl ruVic
asl RAIN_MSB
asl RAIN_MSB
lda $d010
and #$03
ora RAIN_MSB
sta $d010
lda $d015
ora #$fc
sta $d015
rts

// ---- setFacing ----  IN A = 0 right / 1 left  (from the LF / RT handlers)
setFacing:
sta FACING
// ---- playerFrame ----  point sprites 0/1 at the right frames
playerFrame:
ldy #$00
lda FACING
beq pfRight
ldy #$05
pfRight:
lda POSE_T
beq pfStand
iny
iny
pfStand:
tya
clc
adc #$a0
sta $63f9
adc #$01
sta $63f8
rts

// ---- pickPose ----  bend down for 15 frames after FIRE
pickPose:
lda #15
sta POSE_T
jmp playerFrame

ldx #$01

bcc cdAm
ldx #$10
cmp #13
bcc cdAm
sec

cmp #10
bcc cdBcd
clc
adc #$06

lda #$0d
sta $0753
lda #$01

sta $db53

code:
// FIRE + HOME LATCH RELEASE
// $F8 = joystick state latched by the JOYSTICK macro above
// bit 4 low = fire held, so only release the fire latch once fire is up
lda $F8
and #$10
beq flHeld
lda #$00
sta UV_FIRELATCH
flHeld:
// bits 0-3 all high = no direction held - release the home latch so the
// house can end another day (stops a held UP chaining days at the door)
lda $F8
and #$0f
cmp #$0f
bne hlHeld
lda #$00
sta UV_HOMELATCH
hlHeld:
// DOUBLE-TAP TIMER for planting - the first FIRE on a plantable spot loads 50
// (1 second) into UV_FIRETIMER, see faPlant. Count it down once per frame.
lda UV_FIRETIMER
beq ftDone
dec UV_FIRETIMER
ftDone:

code:
// FIELD DRAW ROUTINES
// PUMPKINS asset = records of  col, row, kind, watered  (4 bytes)
//   col $FE = free slot, col $FF = end of list
//   kind  0      = seed            (tile 5, 1 char, tag 7)
//   kind  1..7   = pumpkin growth  (2 chars, phase = (growth+1)/2, tag phase+1, 7 = ready)
//   kind  $80/81 = weed A / B      (tile 4 / 6, 1 char, tag 6)
//   watered 0/1  - pumpkins draw from source row 1 (the wet pictures) while watered
// Source sheet - row 0 = dirt, dirt, picked, stage1..4 dry   row 1 = weedA, seed, weedB, stage1..4 wet
PUMPKINS = $C300

// ---- drawRecord ----  IN  X = record offset.  Never draws on rows 0-1 (the source sheet)
drawRecord:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
lda PUMPKINS+1,x
cmp #$02
bcc drSkip
sta UV_GOT_ROW
lda PUMPKINS,x
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
bmi drWeed
beq drSeed
clc
adc #$01
lsr
sta UV_PUMPSTATE
asl
clc
adc #$01
sta UV_SRC_X
lda PUMPKINS+3,x
sta UV_SRC_Y
lda UV_PUMPSTATE
clc
adc #$01
sta UV_PUMPTAG
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
clc
adc #$01
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN2
jmp tileUpdate
drSeed:
lda #$01
sta UV_SRC_X
sta UV_SRC_Y
lda #$07
sta UV_PUMPTAG
jmp tileUpdate1
drWeed:
and #$01
asl
sta UV_SRC_X
lda #$01
sta UV_SRC_Y
lda #$06
sta UV_PUMPTAG
jmp tileUpdate1
drSkip:
rts

// ---- drawGround ----  IN  A = source col (0 = dirt, 2 = picked), UV_GOT_COLUMN / UV_GOT_ROW
drawGround:
sta UV_SRC_X
lda #$00
sta UV_SRC_Y
lda #$08
sta UV_PUMPTAG
jmp tileUpdate1

// ---- drawAll ----  every live record (called from init)
drawAll:
ldx #$00
daLoop:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$ff
beq daDone
cmp #$fe
beq daNext
jsr drawRecord
daNext:
ldx UV_PUMPIDX
inx
inx
inx
inx
bne daLoop
daDone:
rts

// ---- tileAddr ----  $FB/$FC = $0400 + UV_GOT_ROW*40 + UV_GOT_COLUMN  (the collision tag of that char)
tileAddr:
lda UV_GOT_ROW
sta $fb
lda #$00
sta $fc
asl $fb
rol $fc
asl $fb
rol $fc
asl $fb
rol $fc
lda $fb
sta $fd
lda $fc
sta $fe
asl $fb
rol $fc
asl $fb
rol $fc
clc
lda $fb
adc $fd
sta $fb
lda $fc
adc $fe
sta $fc
clc
lda $fb
adc UV_GOT_COLUMN
sta $fb
lda $fc
adc #$04
sta $fc
rts

// ---- findRecord ----  IN UV_GOT_COLUMN / UV_GOT_ROW (either half of a pumpkin)
// OUT carry set + X = record, carry clear = nothing there
findRecord:
ldx #$00
frLoop:
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$ff
beq frMiss
cmp #$fe
beq frNext
cmp UV_GOT_COLUMN
beq frRow
ldy PUMPKINS+2,x
beq frNext
bmi frNext
clc
adc #$01
cmp UV_GOT_COLUMN
bne frNext
frRow:
lda PUMPKINS+1,x
cmp UV_GOT_ROW
beq frHit
frNext:
inx
inx
inx
inx
bne frLoop
frMiss:
clc
rts
frHit:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
sec
rts

// ---- freeRecord ----  OUT carry set + X = a free slot, carry clear = list full
freeRecord:
ldx #$00
fzLoop:
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$fe
beq fzHit
cmp #$ff
beq fzMiss
inx
inx
inx
inx
bne fzLoop
fzMiss:
clc
rts
fzHit:
sec
rts

// CLOCK TICK  (runs every frame)
// 50 frames = 1 second, 250 frames = half an hour, 2 halves = 1 hour
// so 10 seconds of play = 1 game hour.  8PM = end of the day.

lda UV_FRAME
cmp #250
bne ckDone
lda #$00
sta UV_FRAME
inc UV_HALF
lda UV_HALF
cmp #$02
bne ckDone
lda #$00
sta UV_HALF
inc UV_HOUR
lda UV_HOUR

lda #$01

nodes.title: Code Block

code:
// FIRE ON THE FIELD  (called by FR after collisionCheck)
// UV_PLANTTYPE = tag of the probed char, UV_GOT_COLUMN / UV_GOT_ROW = where
//   2..5 pumpkin  - ready (growth 7) = pick it, otherwise water it
//   6    weed     - stomp it (back to dirt tile 1)
//   7    seed     - nothing (seeds sprout on their own after 1-2 days)
//   0/8  grass or dirt - plant a seed (costs 1 of UV_SEEDS, rows 2-18, the char to the
//                  right must be grass/dirt too, and no seed directly to the left).
//                  Needs a DOUBLE TAP - the first FIRE arms the spot for 1 second
//                  (UV_FIRETIMER, counted down every frame in the main loop), a
//                  second FIRE on the same spot inside that second plants it.
fireAction:
lda UV_GOT_ROW
cmp #$02
bcc faDone
lda UV_PLANTTYPE
cmp #$08
beq faPlant
cmp #$00
beq faPlant
cmp #$06
beq faStomp
cmp #$02
bcc faDone
cmp #$06
bcs faDone
jsr findRecord
bcc faDone
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
cmp #$07
bcs faPick
faWet:
lda #$01
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
jmp drawRecord
faDone:
rts

faPick:
sed
clc
lda UV_PUMPCOUNT
adc #$01
sta UV_PUMPCOUNT
cld
lda PUMPKINS,x
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda PUMPKINS+1,x
sta UV_GOT_ROW
lda #$fe
sta PUMPKINS,x
lda #$02
jsr drawGround
inc UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda #$02
jmp drawGround

faStomp:
jsr findRecord
bcc faDone
lda #$fe
sta PUMPKINS,x
lda #$00
jmp drawGround

faPlant:
lda UV_SEEDS
beq faDone
lda UV_GOT_ROW
cmp #19
bcs faDone
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
cmp #39
bcs faDone
jsr tileAddr
ldy #$01
lda ($fb),y
beq faPlantR
cmp #$08
bne faDone
faPlantR:
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
beq faPlantOk
lda $fb
bne faPlantDec
dec $fc
faPlantDec:
dec $fb
ldy #$00
lda ($fb),y
cmp #$07
beq faDone
faPlantOk:
// double tap - timer still running AND same spot as the first press = plant
lda UV_FIRETIMER
beq faArm
lda UV_ARMCOL
cmp UV_GOT_COLUMN
bne faArm
lda UV_ARMROW
cmp UV_GOT_ROW
bne faArm
lda #$00
sta UV_FIRETIMER
jsr freeRecord
bcs faPlantGo
rts
faPlantGo:
sed
sec
lda UV_SEEDS
sbc #$01
sta UV_SEEDS
cld
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
sta PUMPKINS,x
lda UV_GOT_ROW
sta PUMPKINS+1,x
lda #$00
sta PUMPKINS+2,x
lda $d41b
and #$01
clc
adc #$01
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
jmp drawRecord

// first press (or a press somewhere else) - arm this spot for 50 frames = 1 second
faArm:
lda #50
sta UV_FIRETIMER
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
sta UV_ARMCOL
lda UV_GOT_ROW
sta UV_ARMROW
rts

code:
// END OF DAY ON THE FIELD  (called after the blink)
// seeds sprout into saplings when their day count runs out (1-2 days, no water
// needed), watered pumpkins grow one step and dry out, then 1-4 weeds sprout on the
// grass (tag 0) anywhere in rows 2-18 - never on the dirt patch. Stomping one
// turns that spot into dirt tile 1, which can then be planted.
fieldEndDay:
ldx #$00
edLoop:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$ff
bne edLive
jmp edWeeds
edLive:
cmp #$fe
beq edNext
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
bmi edNext
bne edPumpkin
// ---- seed - byte 3 counts the days down, then it sprouts by itself ----
lda PUMPKINS+3,x
beq edSprout
dec PUMPKINS+3,x
bne edNext
edSprout:
lda PUMPKINS,x
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda PUMPKINS+1,x
sta UV_GOT_ROW
jsr tileAddr
ldy #$01
lda ($fb),y
beq edSproutOk
cmp #$08
beq edSproutOk
cmp #$07
bne edNext
// a seed on the right gets swallowed by the new sapling
stx UV_TRIES
inc UV_GOT_COLUMN
jsr findRecord
bcc edSproutBack
lda #$fe
sta PUMPKINS,x
edSproutBack:
dec UV_GOT_COLUMN
ldx UV_TRIES
stx UV_PUMPIDX
edSproutOk:
ldx UV_PUMPIDX
lda #$01
sta PUMPKINS+2,x
lda #$00
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
jsr drawRecord
jmp edNext
// ---- pumpkin - only grows if it was watered today ----
edPumpkin:
lda PUMPKINS+3,x
beq edNext
lda #$00
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
cmp #$07
bcs edDraw
clc
adc #$01
sta PUMPKINS+2,x
edDraw:
jsr drawRecord
edNext:
ldx UV_PUMPIDX
inx
inx
inx
inx
beq edWeeds
jmp edLoop

// ---- weeds ----  SID voice 3 noise at $D41B is the random source
edWeeds:
lda $d41b
and #$03
clc
adc #$01
sta UV_WEEDN
edWeedLoop:
lda #$20
sta UV_TRIES
edTry:
lda $d41b
and #$3f
cmp #40
bcs edTryAgain
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda $d41b
and #$1f
cmp #$02
bcc edTryAgain
cmp #19
bcs edTryAgain
sta UV_GOT_ROW
jsr tileAddr
ldy #$00
lda ($fb),y
bne edTryAgain
jsr freeRecord
bcc edWeedsDone
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
sta PUMPKINS,x
lda UV_GOT_ROW
sta PUMPKINS+1,x
lda $d41b
and #$01
ora #$80
sta PUMPKINS+2,x
lda #$00
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
jsr drawRecord
jmp edWeedNext
edTryAgain:
dec UV_TRIES
bne edTry
edWeedNext:
dec UV_WEEDN
bne edWeedLoop
edWeedsDone:
rts
